definitions.explanation: A venue that displays and often sells works of art, particularly paintings. Refers to both commercial galleries and exhibition spaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀座|ぎんざ}→銀座：30631_ginza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画廊|がろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}った→巡る：03930_meguru⟧。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{画廊|がろう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{個展|こてん}→個展：15068_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A friend of mine is holding a solo exhibition at a gallery.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{画廊|がろう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This gallery mainly handles works by young artists.

notes:
USAGE:
{画廊|がろう} has a more traditional, refined nuance compared to the loanword ⟦ギャラリー→ギャラリー：10833_gyararii⟧. It is often used for smaller, established galleries that deal in fine art, especially paintings. ⟦ギャラリー→ギャラリー：10833_gyararii⟧ is broader and more casual, also used for photography exhibitions and modern art spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画廊|がろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (to visit galleries)
- {画廊|がろう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{個展|こてん}→個展：15068_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a solo exhibition at a gallery)
- {画廊|がろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to display at a gallery)
- {貸|かし}{画廊|がろう} (rental gallery)

FORMS:
{画|が} (painting, picture) + {廊|ろう} (corridor, gallery).
